nouns.note: bba on its own already means my father (or dad).
mmi on its own already means my mother (or mom). The book writes her mother as mha; mmha is the Casablanca form.
With an ending it means wife: mrati, my wife.
With an ending it means husband: rajlha, her husband.
ṣbbaṭ is a pair of shoes; ṣbabṭ is several pairs.
